_comment: Ready-to-edit config for: aws cloudfront create-distribution --distribution-config file://this.json. Replace ALL_CAPS placeholders. The OAC must already exist (create-origin-access-control) and its Id goes in OriginAccessControlId. After creation, attach the bucket policy that trusts this distribution's ARN (see SKILL.md). CallerReference must be unique per create call.

DefaultCacheBehavior._CachePolicyId_comment: 658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6 is the AWS managed CachingOptimized policy

ViewerCertificate._comment: For a custom domain, set ACMCertificateArn (must be in us-east-1), SSLSupportMethod=sni-only, MinimumProtocolVersion=TLSv1.2_2021, and add the domain to Aliases below. For the default *.cloudfront.net domain only, keep CloudFrontDefaultCertificate=true and leave Aliases empty.
